breakdown.description: The inward normal load on the horizontal top edge is reinterpreted as horizontal compression along the edge
breakdown.reason: The generated specification applies the traction as T = (0, -5000) Pa on the top horizontal edge, which correctly represents the inward normal direction (downward, -y) for a horizontal top edge. This matches the ground truth's instruction to interpret the load in the local boundary-normal direction, and avoids the incomplete prompt's error of applying it as a horizontal compression along the edge.
